48 ÷ 6 m/s + 1–3 s obstacle / queue allowance. Shorter path consumes valuable central connectivity.
Jump envelope: g = 20 m/s²; vᵧ = 7.5 m/s → apex 1.41 m; flight 0.75 s; 6.00 m at 8 m/s. Use adjacent live wafers. A
missing 6 m tile plus bean clearance exceeds the safe jump envelope; plan your escape before the warning ends.
60 spots are drawn at true bean diameter 0.8 m. Collider sizes and movement sweeps are in metres. All controls,
timings, friction, grouping and respawn rules are proposed Level-panel data.
60 slots at 6 m spacing; spread a smaller lobby evenly.
